checks.pass_rule: Bound lambda_max(110 C) = ln(1 / f_min) / 240 min from the co-heated standards, f_min in [1e-6, 1e-2] declared. Shipped sink REFUTED if above lambda_max at f_min 1e-6; consistent if below at 1e-2. Forward Schieberle T4 (MFT 360/30, 720/30; noise 0.06 dex per ratio from the lab's <= 10 % SIDA reproducibility) with k_mft_decay at the two corners (Ea held), at 0, and with Gigl's central Ea; EXPLAINS if both ratios within 0.06 dex and no B60 in-sample row moves out (|r| grows > 1 and ends > 2); REFUTES (a) as sufficient if even k_mft_decay = 0 leaves 360/30 > 0.12 dex low.

MF-01 NOT EXPLAINED: Schieberle 360/30, 720/30 residuals -0.83 / -1.17 (loose bound; no row out), -0.23 / -0.38 (tight bound; 5 rows out), -0.03 / +0.06 (k_mft_decay 0; 7 rows out), -0.96 / -1.30 (Gigl central Ea; 3 rows out). Candidate (a) NOT refuted as sufficient. A temperature-only law needs Ea ~176 kJ/mol (outside Gigl's range); the cysteine ordering of the pots points to M1's C2.
